name: Nicola Castellano

residences.place: 1003 Bunker Hill Street, Scranton Ward 10, PA
residences.note: Head, 42, born Italy, naturalized, owned home ($1,700); car repairer for a railroad company; wife Josephine 35; Vito, Carmella, Marie.

bioAdditions: In 1940 Nicholas Castellano, 42, born in Italy and naturalized, owned 1003 Bunker Hill Street and worked as a railroad car repairer (S1). He had died before his wife Josephine, who died in Phoenix in 1995 and was not survived by a husband (S2). FamilySearch gives him 1898–1982.
